title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B8.5)

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M2.4 (Peaked November 19, 2026 at 13:24 UTC)
